paragraphs: A LeetCode-style website for practicing software engineering interviews: coding problems with a real editor and hidden test cases, pattern lessons, and system design books.
features: Problems: every coding problem from the Grokking pattern course, plus curated and company lists (Blind 75, NeetCode 150, Grind, CTCI, BCTCI, SQL 50, Concurrency, Object-Oriented Design, ML Coding and company lists),…

Workspace: problem description, worked solution and your submission history on the left; a Monaco editor (Python 3, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++ or Go) and a Testcase / Test Result console on the right.
Hints and complexity check: hints reveal one step at a time (topics, pattern, approach), and you state the time and space complexity before comparing with the reference.
Submit checks it against every case, including hidden edge cases, and reports Accepted, Wrong Answer, Runtime Error, Compile Error or Time Limit Exceeded.
Patterns: the course lessons, with diagrams, math and highlighted code in both languages.

whatItDoes.text: A LeetCode-style website for practicing software engineering interviews: coding problems with a real editor and hidden test cases, pattern lessons, and system design books.

requirements.text: The crawler stores facts only (problem, company, how many sources mention it), honours robots.txt, rate-limits each host and skips login or paywalled pages.
